info.name: 📌 Ollama API (Localhost & Cloud)
info.description:
### About

"Ollama is the easiest way to run and build with open AI models locally or in the cloud on macOS, Windows, and Linux."

Ollama runs open models from other labs on your machine via REST API, Python SDK or CLI, and Ollama Cloud runs larger ones for you. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Run locally**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Ollama Account: [https://ollama.com/](https://ollama.com/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `ollama_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:ollama_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- Models: [https://ollama.com/library](https://ollama.com/library)
